label: RUCKUS ICX 7150-24F
description: RUCKUS ICX 7150-24F fibre access switch: 24x 100/1000 Mbps SFP downlinks, 2x 1G RJ-45 uplinks, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplink/stacking, no PoE, 180 Gbps switching capacity.
notes: Datasheet: 24x 100/1000 Mbps SFP ports, 2x 10/100/1000 Mbps uplink RJ-45 ports, 4x 1/10 GbE uplink/stacking SFP/SFP+. All 24 downlinks are fibre cages, so this box cannot take a copper access lead - that is the point of the -24F, and modelling the downlinks as RJ-45 would be the exact error this catalogue exists to avoid. DISCREPANCY: the technical specification page port table says two SFP+ 1-GbE/10-GbE ports for this model, while the family datasheet and the hardware guide model table both say four SFP+ uplink and four stacking. The spec follows the two sources that agree; the conflict is recorded here rather than silently resolved. No PoE.
